summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2002, BWBR0013736, Stcrt. 2002, 104, consolidated text in force from 2026-04-08

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU counter-terrorism measures of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles the regulation lists, departs from them only where an authorisation under the EU regulation's own derogations applies, and gives the information that regulation asks for to De Nederlandsche Bank.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2002 II, BWBR0013904, Stcrt. 2002, 138, consolidated text in force from 2022-01-28

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that applies the freeze and the other rules of Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 to the persons, groups and entities marked with a star in the annex to Common Position 2001/931/CFSP. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank screens for those starred names, applies the EU freeze rules to them, sends the information concerned only to the Ministry of Finance, and acts outside the prohibitions only under a ministerial exemption.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2007, BWBR0021311, Stcrt. 2007, 39, consolidated text in force from 2019-11-20

text.en: The Dutch national terrorism sanctions regulation that freezes the assets of the persons named in its own annex, made with a view to Security Council Resolution 1373. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank screens its clients and payments against the annex, freezes whatever belongs to a listed person, provides no financial services to them and makes no assets available, unless a minister has granted an exemption.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling terrorisme 2007-II, BWBR0023131, Stcrt. 2007, 248, consolidated text in force from 2019-11-20

text.en: The Dutch regulation behind the national terrorism list: the Minister of Foreign Affairs designates persons and organisations by a decision announced in the Staatscourant, and their assets are frozen. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank follows each designation announced in the Staatscourant, freezes the designated party's assets, provides it no financial services and makes no assets available to it, unless a minister grants an exemption.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling ISIS en Al Qaida 2016, BWBR0038916, Stcrt. 2016, 67860, consolidated text in force from 2025-12-25

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU measures against ISIS (Da'esh), Al-Qaida and associated persons, Regulation (EC) No 881/2002 and Regulation (EU) 2016/1686, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, relies only on the derogations the regulation names, and deals with the Minister of Finance or the Minister for Foreign Trade on the matters the EU regulations leave to the competent authority.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling territoriale integriteit Oekraïne 2014, BWBR0034955, Stcrt. 2014, 8792, consolidated text in force from 2026-08-04

text.en: The Dutch regulation that turns the EU asset freeze of Regulation (EU) No 269/2014 and the Russia measures of Regulation (EU) No 833/2014 into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities they refer to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, gives the information those regulations ask for to De Nederlandsche Bank, and answers information requests of the Minister of Economic Affairs.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling destabiliserende activiteiten Russische Federatie 2024, BWBR0050553, Stcrt. 2024, 41510, consolidated text in force from 2026-06-30

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU measures over Russia's destabilising activities, Regulation (EU) 2024/2642, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities they refer to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, relies only on the derogations the regulation names, and gives the information the EU regulation asks for to De Nederlandsche Bank.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling Belarus 2006, BWBR0020371, Stcrt. 2006, 196, consolidated text in force from 2026-08-04

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU measures against Belarus, Regulation (EC) No 765/2006, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities they refer to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, sends the information the EU regulation asks of credit institutions to De Nederlandsche Bank, and answers information requests of the Minister of Economic Affairs.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling Iran 2012, BWBR0031496, Stcrt. 2012, 8001, consolidated text in force from 2026-03-06

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns three EU Iran regimes into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977: the nuclear-related measures of Regulation (EU) No 267/2012, the human rights measures of Regulation (EU) No 359/2011 and the measures over military support to Russia of Regulation (EU) 2023/1529. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed and sends its notifications, requests and information to the Dutch authorities the regulation names.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling Syrië 2012, BWBR0031305, Stcrt. 2012, 3549, consolidated text in force from 2025-07-05

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU measures over the situation in Syria, Regulation (EU) No 36/2012, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities they refer to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, relies only on the derogations the regulation names, and addresses requests and information to the Minister of Foreign Affairs or the Minister of Finance.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling Libië 2016, BWBR0037684, Stcrt. 2016, 11586, consolidated text in force from 2026-07-04

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU measures over the situation in Libya, Regulation (EU) 2016/44, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities they refer to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed and turns to the Minister of Finance to release frozen funds, for financing and financial assistance, and with the information the EU regulation asks for.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling Noord-Korea 2017, BWBR0040211, Stcrt. 2017, 66076, consolidated text in force from 2023-05-02

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU measures against North Korea, Regulation (EU) 2017/1509, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities they refer to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, sends the information the EU regulation asks for to the Minister of Finance or the FIU-Netherlands, and addresses the matters the EU regulation leaves to the competent authority to the Minister of Finance.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Sanctieregeling mensenrechtenschendingen 2020, BWBR0044518, Stcrt. 2020, 66141, consolidated text in force from 2024-06-12

text.en: The Dutch sanctions regulation that turns the EU's global human rights sanctions, Regulation (EU) 2020/1998, into prohibitions under the Sanctions Act 1977 and names the Dutch authorities it refers to. It binds everyone in the Netherlands, banks included. In practice a bank does not act against the EU articles listed, relies only on the derogations the regulation names, and turns to the Minister of Finance to release frozen funds and with financial information.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit Markttoegang financiële ondernemingen Wft, BWBR0020413, Stb. 2006, 506, consolidated text in force from 2026-09-22

text.en: The Dutch decree that says what a financial undertaking hands the supervisor to enter the market: the data of a licence application and of a notification to operate abroad. It binds banks, payment and e-money institutions, investment firms and the other undertakings it names. In practice a bank files its licence and passport data on the supervisor's form and in full, a payment institution adds its business plan, security policy and safeguarding, and a provider relying on the payment exclusions the decree names notifies De Nederlandsche Bank.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Vrijstellingsregeling Wft, BWBR0020536, Stcrt. 2006, 229, consolidated text in force from 2026-09-29

text.en: The Dutch Minister of Finance's regulation that exempts firms from parts of the Financial Supervision Act, many of them on conditions. Its conditions bind the small payment service providers and small e-money institutions that use an exemption instead of a licence. In practice such a firm stays under the volume and storage limits, keeps people with relevant criminal antecedents out of its management, notifies De Nederlandsche Bank and every relevant change, safeguards users' funds and files yearly returns.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling specifieke bepalingen IFR en IFD, BWBR0045790, Stcrt. 2021, 45420, consolidated text in force from 2026-02-11

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's regulation that applies the investment firm capital rules of the IFR to fund managers that also provide investment services, and settles options of the IFR and IFD. It binds those managers and investment firms. In practice such a manager holds the higher of its fund-manager capital and its IFR capital, calculated over its whole business, and an investment firm runs an internal capital assessment even when small, uses the CRR delta formulas only where they work, and fills missing history with its business projections.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020415, Stb. 2006, 508, consolidated text in force from 2026-09-22

text.en: The Dutch decree on supplementary supervision of financial groups: banks and investment firms with a mixed-activity holding as parent, and financial conglomerates. It binds the banks, investment firms and conglomerate parents concerned. In practice a bank in such a group reports its significant intragroup transactions every year, and the head of a conglomerate keeps conglomerate-wide risk management, calculates supplementary capital adequacy by an approved method, and reports it with risk concentrations and intragroup transactions to De Nederlandsche Bank.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling prudentieel toezicht financiële groepen Wft, BWBR0020705, Stcrt. 2006, 246, consolidated text in force from 2009-01-01

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's regulation that fills in the reports of financial groups: which intragroup transactions and risk concentrations count as significant, on which sheet of its form they go and by when. It binds credit institutions with a mixed-activity holding as parent and the heads of financial conglomerates. In practice such a bank or conglomerate reports positions above 20 per cent of the relevant capital measure within two or four months after the financial year ends, broken down as the regulation prescribes.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit verbod op de markt brengen, verspreiden of verkopen van binaire opties aan niet-professionele cliënten ex Verordening (EU) nr. 600/2014 en Wet op het financieel toezicht, BWBR0042121, Stcrt. 2019, 21122, consolidated text in force from 2019-04-19

text.en: The Authority for the Financial Markets' product intervention decision that bans marketing, distributing or selling binary options to retail clients in or from the Netherlands. It binds banks and investment firms that offer derivatives to retail clients. In practice a bank offers retail clients no binary option unless the option falls under one of the two exceptions for products that cannot lose the client's stake or that run for at least ninety days under a prospectus, and it takes no part in arrangements to get round the ban.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit verwijzingsportaal bankgegevens, BWBR0043903, Stb. 2020, 264, consolidated text in force from 2022-01-01

text.en: The Dutch decree on the bank data referral portal, the central system through which investigators, the public prosecutor, the FIU-Netherlands and other named authorities request identifying data from banks. It binds the banks and other payment service providers connected to the portal under Article 3:267i of the Wft. In practice a bank keeps a secure connection open day and night, answers account checks within five seconds and other requests within thirty, supplies data at most 48 hours old, and deletes requests it holds no data for.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Regeling eed of belofte financiële sector 2015, BWBR0036152, Stcrt. 2014, 37261, consolidated text in force from 2015-04-01

text.en: The Dutch Minister of Finance's regulation that sets how the financial sector oath or affirmation is taken. It binds banks and the other financial firms whose policymakers, supervisory board members and staff must take it under the Financial Supervision Act. In practice a bank has every new policymaker, board member and employee concerned take the oath within three months, before a person in a higher position where possible, on the prescribed form or its own form with the required elements, and keeps the signed forms.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit marktmisbruik Wft, BWBR0020417, Stb. 2006, 510, consolidated text in force from 2024-04-01

text.en: The Dutch decree on how banks, investment firms, fund managers, insurers and pension funds handle inside information and private transactions, and on the Dutch ban on investing in cluster munitions. It binds the firms Article 5:68 of the Financial Supervision Act names. In practice a bank keeps inside information within need-to-know circles, does not invest in, lend to or hold stakes in cluster munitions producers, appoints a compliance officer, records its own-account trades, and runs a code of conduct for staff's private transactions.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit erkenning 4,5% systeemrisicobuffer Noorwegen 2023, BWBR0048576, Stcrt. 2023, 23927, consolidated text in force from 2025-12-01

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's decision that recognises the systemic risk buffer of 4.5 per cent that Norway's Ministry of Finance applies to Norwegian exposures. It binds Dutch banks and investment firms under the CRR with risk-weighted exposures in Norway above NOK 5 billion. In practice such a bank holds the Norwegian buffer rate on those exposures at every level of consolidation where the CRR applies.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit erkenning 1% systeemrisicobuffer Duitsland 2025, BWBR0047799, Stcrt. 2023, 2784, consolidated text in force from 2025-12-01

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's decision that recognises Germany's systemic risk buffer on exposures secured by residential real estate in Germany, now at 1 per cent. It binds Dutch banks and investment firms under the CRR whose German residential real estate exposures exceed EUR 10 billion. In practice such a bank holds the buffer on those exposures, where it uses the standardised approach with full real estate cover or the internal ratings based approach, at every level of consolidation where the CRR applies.

summaries.sourceLabel: Wetten.nl (Overheid.nl), official repository of consolidated law, Besluit erkenning 1% systeemrisicobuffer Italië 2026, BWBR0052606, Stcrt. 2026, 17078, consolidated text in force from 2026-05-09

text.en: De Nederlandsche Bank's decision that recognises the macroprudential measure of Banca d'Italia: a systemic risk buffer of 1 per cent on exposures located in Italy. It binds Dutch banks and investment firms under the CRR whose credit and counterparty credit risk exposures in Italy exceed EUR 25 billion. In practice such a bank holds the Italian buffer rate on those exposures at every level of consolidation where the CRR applies.
